# GenSmart

> GenSmart is a multichannel agentic platform for creating AI agents that answer, sell and book appointments in your customers' conversations. It is built for small and medium businesses, freelancers and agencies, and is available in Spanish and English.

## What it does

- Six channels: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, email and your website.
- Unified inbox for every conversation, across channels.
- CRM with a sales funnel (lead, opportunity, customer). The agent scores each lead from 0 to 10 once a conversation reaches 6 messages; a score of 7 or higher moves the contact to customer.
- Appointment booking: the agent checks calendar availability and books during the conversation.
- Knowledge base for each agent, built from files and web pages.
- Handoff to a person with a summary and the full history (Starter plan and up).
- Integrations through API calls (custom functions) and MCP servers, including webhook-triggered integrations.
- Voice notes (Starter and up) and image understanding (Pro and up).

## What it does not do

GenSmart does not send WhatsApp templates or bulk messages. The agent replies to people who wrote first, within WhatsApp's 24-hour window.

## Plans

Solo, Starter and Pro include a 15-day free trial; Enterprise is arranged with sales. Prices in USD per month.

- Solo: 1 agent, 200 messages/month, 150 contacts, web and WhatsApp. $20/month.
- Starter: 3 agents, 1,000 messages/month, 500 contacts, all six channels. $29/month.
- Pro: 10 agents, 5,000 messages/month, 2,000 contacts, all six channels. $79/month.
- Enterprise: unlimited agents, 25,000 messages/month, unlimited contacts, all six channels. $199/month.
- Quarterly billing: 10% off. Yearly billing: 20% off.
